query: Please implement an informational web application to integrate external API data. The application should have functionalities for configuring external API connections, displaying API data, and managing API requests. Users should be able to configure API connections, view API data, manage API requests, and perform corresponding actions as needed. Apply honeydew to the canvas background and forest green to all visible components.
